detail.longDescription:
Your coding agent doesn't need a smarter model — it needs a better approval surface.

Case in point: plannotator (github.com/backnotprop/plannotator), 11.6k stars and climbing. Your agent proposes a plan, it opens a local browser UI: annotate, send structured feedback, agent revises. Plan diff shows what changed.

Generation got cheap; verification is the bottleneck. The hottest tools keep a human in the loop without parking the agent. Approval is becoming the interface.

#AIAgents #devtools
